leadText: My First Wide: Volume 2 (Japanese: My First WIDE: ポケットモンスターSPECIAL ルビーサファイア編 2 My First Wide: Ruby Sapphire Chapter volume 2) was intended to be the second volume of an omnibus compilation of the of the Pokémon Adventures manga authored by Hidenori Kusaka and illustrated by Satoshi Yamamoto.
plainText:
My First Wide: Volume 2 (Japanese: My First WIDE: ポケットモンスターSPECIAL ルビーサファイア編 2 My First Wide: Ruby Sapphire Chapter volume 2) was intended to be the second volume of an omnibus compilation of the of the Pokémon Adventures manga authored by Hidenori Kusaka and illustrated by Satoshi Yamamoto.

==Publications==
While the ISBN and release date were tentatively confirmed for this volume, it has not been released anywhere in the world.
 
 

==Cancellation==
While the first volume was released in Japan on March 31, 2011, it was decided that the second and third volumes would be cancelled, and the first volume quietly went out of print. The reason for this is due to the depictions of earthquakes and tsunamis in the , which were deemed inappropriate due to the recent . 

In 2014, in coordination with the upcoming release of Pokémon Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire, a new omnibus release of the was announced under Shogakukan's "My First Series" (マイファーストシリーズ) brand of volumes sold in convenience stores. Satoshi Yamamoto has confirmed on his Twitter account that the new series of volumes has no connection to the 2011 releases and that the 2011 releases have been permanently discontinued.
